events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Anarchy in [city]

options.text: Distract the citizens with lavish games.
Burn the council's building down while they're in it.
Invite the council to dinner to win them over.

events.text: In the aftermath of battle, disorder reigns in [city]. Members of the local governing council refuse to impose order.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: City Ablaze

options.text: Retrieve all of the finest treasures and works of art.
Rescue nobles from their baths and estates.
Shelter and care for the lowliest citizens.

events.text: As [rival] soldiers hurl incendiaries into [city], fires break out around the city, causing damage and disorder. The city militia wishes to know what they should rescue before it is too late.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Defiance

options.text: We stand with [city]! We stand with [rival]!
Dying for your [title] is the highest honor!

events.text: The recent attacks on [city] have inspired a citizen uprising. Our subjects have armed themselves and are taking to the streets to defend the city. The court asks you to issue a declaration celebrating this act of defiance. What will be the theme of your speech?

events.author: Solver
events.name: Fifth Column

options.text: Execute [character] as an example to all [family].
[family] may disapprove of me, but they would never work with [rival].
Call upon the citizens of [city] to defend, nobles be damned.
If [rival] troops encounter a [family] patrol, that would buy time for repairs.

events.text: While [city] is under assault from [rival] forces, rumors reach you that local elites from the [family] family in [city] are secretly helping the [rival] with the goal of undermining your rule. If there is any truth to this, it would be an unprecedented betrayal of everyone in [city].

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: In Defense of the Holy City

options.text: Rally the faithful to take up arms in defense of [city].
Hire mercenaries to defend the walls.
Divert your armies to defend the holy city.

events.text: News quickly spreads across [rival] that [religion] Holy City of [city] is under attack. The night skies fill with the glow of fires as the [religion] leaders guide their gathered followers in <p.is_sub.S1=SUBJECT_ZOROASTRIANISM>sacrifices<p=SUBJECT_RELIGION_PAGAN>sacrifices<else>prayers<end> for the safety of the holy city. [character] makes an impassioned plea before the court, asking for aid.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: No Way Out

options.text: Clearly, he was not a leader.

events.text: As the defenses of [city] begin to collapse, officers of our defending forces rush to the palace to protect the governor, [character]. They find [character] dead on the floor of the city council chambers. He took his own life rather than face the enemy.

events.author: Brodie Frehlich
events.name: Oathbound

tip: As leader: Stat Bonus: Unit Military Killed → Avenger Oath Kill Unit
As leader: Stat Bonus: Improvement Repaired → Avenger Oath Repair Improvement
As leader: Stat Bonus: Improvement Finished → Avenger Oath Build Improvement

options.text: [rival] will pay. This I swear.

tip: As leader: Stat Bonus: Improvement Repaired → Rebuilder Oath Repair Improvement
As leader: Stat Bonus: Improvement Finished → Rebuilder Oath Build Improvement
As leader: Stat Bonus: Unit Military Killed → Rebuilder Oath Kill Unit

options.text: I will see [city] rebuilt immediately.
A rigid path will only lead us astray in this changing world.

events.text: [rival] shows no mercy, bearing down on [city] while the [event] is upon us. The [family] are furious and demand a swift response.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Prison Conscripts

options.text: We will conscript the prisoners.
No, I will not risk the trouble.

events.text: As the enemy descends upon [city], [character] approaches you with a suggestion. He proposes that the prisons of [city] should be emptied and the prisoners conscripted into the army. They wouldn’t be trained, but it could be an effective way of bolstering your armed forces. Shall we send out a decree?

events.author: Solver
events.name: Recruitment Drive

options.text: Prepare to fight the invaders in every street.
We need all the fighters we can get right now.

events.text: With [city] under attack, [character] shows that you were right to entrust him with the running of the city. [character] arrives at the Barracks even as fires rage in the city's outskirts and personally guides volunteers willing to defend their homes. We could instruct [character] to hide weapons around the city and prepare the citizens for a battle in the streets, or we could have him pick the most able volunteers to join the city's defense immediately.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Safe Houses

options.text: Defend the innocents and all those in harm's way.
Keep the enemy from our storehouses at all costs.
Evacuate the nobles and save their possessions.

events.text: [city] is under siege! The defenses have been slow to muster, but the city leadership is organizing militias to protect key locations in the city. Where should they focus their efforts?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: The End of a Siege

options.text: Bring the horse inside. Let us celebrate our victory.
Burn it down - it's a trap!

events.text: After a long siege of our [city], the [rival] soldiers have retreated, leaving a large wooden horse in front of your Walls.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Three Crowned Kings

options.text: We stand together.
I need your armies, not your words.

events.text: [family], [family], and [family] may be locked in a constant struggle for supremacy, but in one thing they are all united: [rival] will not fall to [rival]. As the enemy troops draw close to [city], all three have sent assurances that they will follow your lead.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: To Arms

options.text: More fighters are desperately needed.
Provide intelligence and support for soldiers.
Help calm and reassure their fellow citizens.

events.text: As [city] burns, citizens come to the palace, eager to aid in the defense of their city. The local military rushes to form a defense, but there are many opportunities for volunteers. How should these brave men and women help?
